_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-01 · Session 90 (SkySherpa) · Sierra's standalone page got its brand: CPL Initiative logo + Mt Whitney + "Your CPL Sherpa"
_status: Session 90 was a quick visual pass on the shareable Sierra page (sierra/): her header now leads with the official CPL Initiative logo, has a subtle Mt Whitney ridgeline traced behind the 'Sierra' name (with a touch of snow at the peak — Whitney is the tallest peak in the Sierra Nevada), and a new tagline, 'Your CPL Sherpa.' All live. — Prior context: Sierra also got a lot smarter for detailed questions. She could only search the credit colleges have ALREADY set up (the exhibit list); now she can also search the full COCI course + program catalog — what each college actually TEACHES — plus a region/county map of all 120 colleges. So for a question like the Boys & Girls Club's (get their teens NCCER/OSHA/welding credit at LA Harbor / El Camino / Long Beach), she can reason: LA Harbor teaches 0 construction-trades courses, but El Camino (25) and Long Beach City (14) DO, and Norco/Barstow already articulated NCCER — so she routes you to the right nearby college and frames it as an easy adoption, instead of dead-ending at 'no exhibit.' Live now on both the dashboard tab AND the public map.rccd.edu widget (cpl-chat v20).

items.text: Optional Sierra polish: want the new Mt Whitney mark carried into the little chat avatar (still a 🏔️ emoji) and/or the browser tab icon? It's a reusable graphic now — just say the word and Fable will drop it in.
